items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: I know we had a tenor player, Marvin Cabell (PHONETIC).

ctx.x: Can you talk a little bit about what you were doing musically in the latter part of the '60s?

Well, I wasn't doing anything around Chicago and my mother died. Musically, it just seemed like there wasn't nothing happening out there with me and I had a bad drinking habit at that time. I kind of got into that A.A. and decided to come back to New York. More musical, you know, more so than Chicago. Chicago was into the organ things, organ groups, with a few clubs out there. Before I left Chicago, though, I worked a little concert with Billy Howell, Campbell (PHONETIC), Wilbur Gamel (PHONETIC) -- let's see, who…
